Once upon a time, there was a little dragon. The dragon lived in a big forest. The dragon was very happy. He liked to play with his friends. One day, the dragon went to the park to play.
The dragon was very happy. He went to the dragon and said, "Hi, I am a big, scary dog. Can I play with you?" The dog said, "Yes, I can help you."
